system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: a self-developing agent harness whose tools, context assembly, prompts and core implementation improve through reviewed commits
system_prompt_style.note: Constitution kept in resident context plus identity, scratchpad, project memory projections; prompt builder file not in evidence.

env_context_strategy.note: Tool registry and context builder not in evidence bundle (ARCHITECTURE.md truncated).

context_compaction.note: Context/compaction code not in evidence; paper mentions bounded digests for channels only.

observation_format.evidence_quote: It uses screenshots, a 100-turn budget, a read-only feasibility pass
observation_format.note: Screenshots from OSWorld adapter; raw_text inferred from shell/tool loop.

edit_primitive.note: Edit tool definitions not in evidence.

tool_schema_source.note: Schema generator not in evidence; MCP tools mentioned in README.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: Skills, transport bridges, widgets, MCP tools, and companion processes expand capability without folding every integration into the core.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote:
Task runtime
Context · model route · tool loop
loop_primitives.note: Supervisor message bus and queue suggest event_driven; tool loop suggests react.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Project tasks add a journal, workpad, knowledge scope, and a one-writer lease under the shared agent identity.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Ouroboros can spawn readonly planning scouts and mutative acting subagents under a configurable task tree (Figures 2 and 3). The default depth is 2
multi_agent_topology.note: Default depth 2 implies delegation on by default; up to 500 depth configurable (hierarchical reachable).

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Ouroboros can spawn readonly planning scouts and mutative acting subagents under a configurable task tree

human_in_loop.note: Owner review policy set in wizard; confirmation mechanism not in evidence. Operator /panic exists.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: Task completion is recorded on separate execution, objective, review, and artifact axes

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: the runtime's durable identity, state, history, logs, and skills under `~/Ouroboros/data/`.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: | `/restart` | Restart without automatically resuming the active owner task. |
state_persistence.note: Terminal deliveries replayed on boot but task not resumed.

self_verification.evidence_quote: host-run verification commands create revision-bound receipts
self_verification.note: Multi-model diff review panel is blocking for self-repo commits (llm_judge).

retry_policy.note: Reaper retry decision mentioned but policy not shown.

rollback.evidence_quote: Rollback re-stores an earlier reviewed state and follows a sepa-rate recovery path.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: distin-guishes capability failures from infrastructure er-rors, timeouts, budget exhaustion, and incomplete evidence.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: The spending limit is external to the agent and cannot be raised through ordinary agent tools.

timeouts.evidence_quote: Task queue management (PENDING/RUNNING lists) + activity-based timeout enforcement

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: The native launcher starts a web runtime and supervisor-managed agent workers.
execution_isolation.note: Docker image available; paper notes complete isolation needs stronger sandbox.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: External workspaces must be separate Git worktree roots and may not overlap Ouroboros's own repository or data directory.

network_policy.note: No network config surface in evidence.

permission_model.evidence_quote: Public presence runs on a strict tool whitelist.
permission_model.note: Runtime modes light/advanced/pro gate repo edits.

tracing.evidence_quote: Use `--jsonl` for a machine-readable event stream

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: Benchmark adapters, run scripts, and per-benchmark methodology live in [`devtools/benchmarks/`](devtools/benchmarks/).

guardrails.evidence_quote: Deterministic guards protect governance files from ordinary write tools.

target_domain.evidence_quote: Ouroboros is an open-source, general-purpose AI agent

open_source.evidence_quote: Ouroboros is released under the MIT license.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: Supported provider APIs and local GGUF models can fill the runtime's configurable cognitive roles.
